content: MDN: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER = 2^53-1 = 9007199254740991; doubles have 52-bit mantissa; MAX_SAFE_INTEGER+1 === MAX_SAFE_INTEGER+2 evaluates true. Twitter developer docs (archived 2019): 'always use id_str instead of id' because Javascript and other JSON parsers munge 64-bit ints; Twitter API returns every ID as both integer and string. Snowflake IDs (timestamp-shifted 63-bit values) exceed 2^53 within days of any sane custom epoch, so JSON string encoding is mandatory.
